Number of studies.evidence_source: This study investigated the significance of different well-established psychometric indicators of creativity for real-life creative outcomes. Therefore, this study aims at investigating the relationship between common psychometric indicators of creativity and real-life creative achievement by means of structural equation modelling.

section_summary.extract_value: This study investigated the significance of creative potential, intelligence, and openness to experiences for everyday creative activities and actual creative achievement using a heterogeneous sample of 297 adults. Latent multiple regression analyses revealed that openness and creative potential predicted everyday creative activities, which in turn predicted creative achievement. Intelligence was found to predict creative achievement and to moderate the effect of creative activities on creative achievement.
